skills_boots_blurb: You walk faster. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_bulk_up_blurb: You carry taller stacks. Each rank adds {step} to the pile you can hold, {crafted} for bottled and jarred goods.
skills_bulk_up_skillblurb: You carry up to {stack} of a kind in hand, {crafted} for bottled and jarred goods.
skills_driving_classes_blurb: You drive faster and burn less fuel. Each rank adds {pct}% to top speed and acceleration, and cuts burn {pct}%.
skills_driving_classes_skillblurb: You drive {pct}% faster and burn {pct}% less fuel.
skills_tending_blurb: Empty-handed, tend a growing plant or an off-season tree once. Plants become slightly happier. Ripe plants cannot be tended.
skills_seed_bank_blurb: There is some chance that seeds bought from the shops have increased rarity.
skills_seed_bank_skillblurb: There is some chance that seeds bought from the shops have increased rarity ({uncommon}% uncommon, {rare}% rare, {heirloom}% heirloom).
skills_better_carrot_blurb: Carrots sell for {pct}% more. Increased chance that a happy plant will produce a superior fruit.
skills_better_potato_blurb: Potatoes sell for {pct}% more. Increased chance that a happy plant will produce a superior fruit.
skills_better_wheat_blurb: Wheat sells for {pct}% more. Increased chance that a happy plant will produce a superior fruit.
skills_better_tomato_blurb: Tomatoes sell for {pct}% more. Increased chance that a happy plant will produce a superior fruit.
skills_better_raspberry_blurb: Raspberries sell for {pct}% more. Increased chance that a happy plant will produce a superior fruit.
skills_better_grape_blurb: Grapes sell for {pct}% more. Increased chance that a happy plant will produce a superior fruit.
skills_better_vanilla_blurb: Vanilla sells for {pct}% more. Increased chance that a happy plant will produce a superior fruit.
skills_better_sugar_cane_blurb: Sugar sells for {pct}% more. Increased chance that a happy plant will produce a superior fruit.
skills_machinery_blurb: Machine work finishes sooner. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_haggling_blurb: Utility and automation goods in the store cost less. Each rank knocks {off} off the price.
skills_haggling_skillblurb: Utility and automation goods in the store cost {off} less. Never below {floor}.
skills_forecast_blurb: Tomorrow's weather appears next to today on the top bar, so you can plan irrigation, the stall, and pump spend before morning.
skills_tax_blurb: By optimizing your taxes, you can shave off {pct}% off your taxes at the end of the day, per rank.
skills_tax_skillblurb: The bill at the end of the day is {pct}% lighter. You still pay at least {floor}.
skills_water_study_blurb: Adds Water need to the Lens menu. You can see wet and dry soil across the field.
skills_land_study_blurb: Adds Land quality to the Lens menu. You can see fertilizer in the dirt across the field.
skills_inherit_land_blurb: A relative signs a plot over to you. Each rank grants one expansion permit. The land still costs money.
skills_saleswoman_blurb: Produce at the stall sells for more. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_saleswoman_skillblurb: Produce at the stall sells for {pct}% more.
skills_heirloom_blurb: You have become a noted quality heirloom producer. Heirloom produce sells for more. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_bio_blurb: Organic fruit sells for more. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_industrial_blurb: Completed contracts pay more. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_broker_blurb: The buyer board grows. Rank I adds one offer. Rank II adds one offer and one running contract.
skills_broker_skillblurb: The buyer board grows by one offer.
skills_broker_skillblurb_ii: The buyer board grows by one offer and you can run one more contract.
skills_open_late_blurb: The stall keeps selling through sunset. It still shuts at twilight.
skills_open_24_blurb: The stall keeps selling through twilight as well.
skills_jam_blurb: Fruit below half freshness rots slower. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_jam_skillblurb: Fruit below half freshness rots {pct}% slower.
